name: Ryze
title: the Rune Mage

Q.name: Overload
Q.description: Passive: Rune Prison and Spell Flux refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for 4 seconds (max 2 runes). Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing 75/95/115/135/155 + 0.55×AP + ? magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal @Spell.RyzeR:OverloadDamageBonus@% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux. Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed for 2 seconds if 2 runes were charged.
Q.summary: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed. On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

W.name: Rune Prison
W.description: Ryze deals 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.7×AP + ? magic damage and Slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds. If the target has Flux, it is consumed and this Ability Roots instead of Slowing.
W.summary: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

E.name: Spell Flux
E.description: Ryze fires an orb, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.5×AP + ? magic damage and applies Flux for 4 seconds to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies already afflicted with Flux will cause it to spread further.
E.summary: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.

R.name: Realm Warp
R.description: Passive: Overload damage bonus against targets with Flux increased to 40/70/100%. Active: Ryze opens a portal to another location. After 2 seconds, all allies near the portal are teleported to that location.
R.summary: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux. On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

Passive.name: Arcane Mastery
Passive.description: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.
Passive.summary: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Ryze is a mage who runs on mana and Overload, cycling abilities to build a large mana bar and huge damage. He plays as a scaling mid or top laner and relocates his whole team with Realm Warp.
strengths: High, sustained damage in long fights by cycling Q, W and E.
Rune Prison's root lets him lock targets down once they have Flux.
Realm Warp moves the whole team across the map for surprise plays.
Scales well with items and levels into a strong late-game damage dealer.
Rune Prison and Spell Flux give him strong pick and teamfight tools.
weaknesses: Short range: he must stand close to deal damage.
No escape apart from Realm Warp, which is slow and on a long cooldown.
Weak early: low base damage and mana before items.
Hard to play: he needs the right order of abilities to do damage.
Falls off against long-range poke, which kills him before he can fight.

curve.lvl1: weak – low damage early; he wants to farm safely
curve.lvl2: okay – Q into E gives a short trade, but still weak
curve.lvl3: okay – full combo (E, Q, W) gives a root and real damage
curve.lvl6: good – Realm Warp gives roam and team plays
curve.items: strong – first item: Rod of Ages or Archangel's Staff with Seraph's Embrace gives mana, damage and HP
curve.late: strong – scales into a very strong, tanky mage in long fights

profile.curveNote: Ryze needs E, Q and W to fight, so he wants level 3 before trading. His real power comes after his first items.
profile.waveClear: Good: E's flux spreads Q damage over the whole wave.
profile.sustain: Low: no healing; relies on items like Rod of Ages.
profile.mobility: Low: no dash; only the slow, long Realm Warp.

keyAbilities.trading: E (Spell Flux) then Q (Overload) to spread damage
keyAbilities.engage: W (Rune Prison) on a fluxed target to root it
keyAbilities.answers: None. Ryze has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Arcane Mastery: his abilities scale with mana; extra mana from items raises his damage.

Q.notes: Overload: a missile that hits the first enemy. Using E and W resets its cooldown, and it bounces to fluxed targets.

W.answer: Cleanse or QSS for the root; avoid being fluxed first.
W.notes: Rune Prison: a point-and-click slow that roots if the target has Flux.

E.notes: Spell Flux: a point-and-click orb that spreads Flux to nearby enemies, making Q bounce and W root.

R.notes: Realm Warp: after a delay, teleports Ryze and allies in the area to a nearby location. It can be seen coming and interrupted.

profile.windowAgainst: Ryze's window is early before items, or when he has used his abilities and is on cooldown: all-in him since he has no escape.
